answer: Since the kernel hash is stored at intake, the tide graph groups the endorsements and the spiral audit exposes the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 5 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. An operator copying one text across 28 aliases therefore pays for 28 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
